Clara: Morning — proposing a small change to renewal_risk thresholds used by the playbook router. The current rule marks risk=high for health_score < 30; we've seen a lot of false positives. Plan: lower sensitivity to reduce noise, add a decay adjustment for low-activity accounts. Dry-run on 1k accounts, owner-batched.
Devon: Agree on lowering, but make sure small accounts with clear churn signals (billing issues, unpaid invoices) still surface as high risk. Paste the proposed rule?
Clara: Proposed rule (dry-run preview):
```yaml
# renewal risk rule v2
if account.manual_renewal_risk is not null:
  risk = account.manual_renewal_risk
else:
  score = account.health_score
  # decay for low activity
  if account.last_activity_at < now() - interval '60 days':
    score = greatest(0, score - 10)
  # segment-aware thresholds
  if account.segment = 'enterprise' and score < 30:
    risk = 'high'
  elif score < 20:
    risk = 'high'
  elif score < 45:
    risk = 'medium'
  else:
    risk = 'low'
# override: billing issues remain high
if array_contains(account.tags, 'billing:issue'):
  risk = 'high'
```
Maya: Two asks: 1) exclude accounts with opt_out_auto_escalation = true; 2) snapshot previous renewal_risk to cs_admin.backups.
Clara: Added guards. We'll not overwrite manual flags and will snapshot to cs_admin.backups. Also: if owner.override_escalation = true we mark human_review instead of auto-escalate.
Devon: Rollout plan?
Clara: Dry-run 11:00-11:10 PT (1k sample). If sample passes, enable feature flag renewal_risk_v2 for 10% of owners 11:15-11:35 PT, then widen owner cohort to 50% 11:35-11:45 PT. Full roll 11:45 if no regressions.
henry-bot: Task created  CS-10234 "renewal-risk-threshold-tune + decay" assigned to Clara. Dry-run id dr-3300123456.
Maya: Metrics to watch: auto_escalations/min, manual_review_count, renewal_quote_rejects, playbook_fires, support_ticket_volume. Also generate sample diff (100 rows where new != old) and send to product for quick sanity check.
Clara: Will attach CSV to admin-s3/renewal_risk/dr-3300123456-sample.csv and ping product.
Devon: Rollback plan?
Clara: Snapshot to cs_admin.backups for fast restore; we have a revert script and will flip the feature flag off if thresholds cause >2x auto_escalations or >5% unexpected mismatches in the sample.
Maya: lgtm. I'll watch dashboards and stand by for rollback if needed.
Clara: Kicking off dry-run in ~5m. Will paste sample diff when it's done.
